home.eyebrow: Welcome to Hosn el Hal · حسن الحال
home.title: A wellbeing resource hub for teachers, by UNICEF
home.lead: Hosn el Hal is a curated collection of wellbeing resources designed to support teachers' mental health and self-care. Here you can find practical tools, guided moments, and reassuring reminders to help you care for yourself and support your school community.

resources.title: Resources
resources.lead: Browse audio, video, PDFs and visual messages. No account needed.

how_to_use.title: How to Use This Hub
how_to_use.lead: Find a resource that fits your needs, view it online or download it to use later.
how_to_use.ways_title: Three ways to use the hub
how_to_use.step_find_text: Search or filter by topic, format, length and language.
how_to_use.step_open_text: Watch videos, listen to audio, and view visual messages or PDFs in your browser.
how_to_use.step_download_text: Download resources for offline use. Print-ready and mobile-friendly versions support different settings.
how_to_use.practical_text: Use a resource on your own, with a small group of colleagues, or with the wider school team. The short notes with each resource provide practical suggestions.

about.title: About Hosn El Hal
about.lead: Simple, practical wellbeing resources for teachers in crisis-affected contexts.
about.background_text_1: Hosn El Hal is a UNICEF programme providing teachers with short psychosocial support resources in audio, video, visual-message and PDF worksheet formats.
about.background_text_2: The first phase developed and validated content with teachers and school counsellors in Lebanon, Palestine, Jordan and Syria. Its visual identity is rooted in the shared landscape of the region.
about.hub_text: This hub brings the materials together in a simple space where teachers can find, use and revisit resources in their own time, with no account required.
